acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Demons family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Imp, T1, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Brand-Snatch Pest Initiate (Initiate) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two wind construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: A cat-sized red pest with pinprick horns, small bat wings, needle teeth, clawed feet, and a whip-thin tail shaped to carry one visible brand token.

Signature mechanic: Petty Theft: the Imp's whip tail hooks a loose brand shed by another Demon's attack or a marked arena object; while carrying it, the cat-sized pest can make one needle-tooth dive, but the token swings visibly behind and drops on any interruption.
battlefieldDuty: Probe target awareness by fluttering behind a marked combatant, stealing one visible infernal brand token with its tail, and becoming bolder only while carrying it.
constructionDimensions: Wing and horn anatomy becomes a pressure instrument through vane-cut membranes, hollow horn whistles, chain sails, tail fins, and armor exhaust channels; the T1's small wings flutter a short impulse while T2–T5 route progressively larger pressure loads.
Motion exposes force direction through membrane camber, smoke streamlines, chain bowing, asymmetric hoof lift, and a still anchor at the brand, horn root, plate seal, or throne channel.
counterplay: Move between the Imp and brand, hit the swinging tail during its straight dive, or collect the dropped token before another Demon can use it. Affinity signal: Membranes and smoke align before a pressure action while the governing brand or horn root becomes still; crossing the lee or striking that anchor collapses the displacement.
forbiddenTreatments: Palette-only wind treatment without vane anatomy, pressure routing, and force direction
Glow-only wind treatment without a still center or mechanical airflow
Generic black smoke that duplicates family-native Archfiend wings without Wind construction
Tornado effects that hide horns, hooves, tail, brands, chains, or wing count
identityInvariants: A horned head, broadening shoulders, digitigrade or hooved legs, long tail, claws, and bat-like wing membranes remain legible from cat-sized pest to enthroned sovereign.
Blood red or ashen hide, char black, source-native ember orange, molten yellow, and obsidian preserve an infernal body whose internal fire is explained anatomy rather than affinity by default.
Charred hide, obsidian, blackened iron, native molten rock, smoke, and bat membrane retain distinct surfaces instead of collapsing into a generic flame silhouette.
Brands, infernal sigils, chains, spiked black armor, skull motifs, and horn arrangements communicate authored rank and command routes without implying a universal moral taxonomy.

Horn count, wing authority, and the proportion of source-native fire or obsidian increase with rank, but every form preserves visible hide, joints, brand routes, and an interruptible hierarchy anchor.
telegraph: Pinprick horns angle back, small bat wings flutter in place, and the whip-thin tail circles one dark-red brand before darting for it.
